import FormalConjecturesUtil

/-!
# Written on the Wall II - Conjecture 7

*Reference:*
[E. DeLaVina, Written on the Wall II, Conjectures of Graffiti.pc](http://cms.dt.uh.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/)
-/

namespace WrittenOnTheWallII.GraphConjecture7

open SimpleGraph

variable {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nontrivial α]

/--
WOWII [Conjecture 7](http://cms.dt.uh.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/)

For a simple connected graph $G$,
$L_s(G) \ge \max_v \lambda(v) - 1 + n - 2 \alpha(G)$,
where $L_s(G)$ is the maximum number of leaves over all spanning trees of $G$,
$n = |V(G)|$, $\alpha(G) = G.\mathrm{indepNum}$ is the independence number, and
$\lambda(v) = \mathrm{indepNeighborsCard}\, G\, v$ is the independence number of the
neighbourhood of $v$.

Proved by DeLaVina, Fajtlowicz, Waller (2002).
-/
@[category research solved, AMS 5]
theorem conjecture7 (G : SimpleGraph α) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (h : G.Connected) :
    let maxL := (Finset.univ.image (fun v => indepNeighborsCard G v)).max' (by simp)
    ((maxL : ℤ) - 1 + (Fintype.card α : ℤ) - 2 * (G.indepNum : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤ Ls G := by
  sorry

-- Sanity checks

/-- The independence number is nonneg. -/
@[category test, AMS 5]
example (G : SimpleGraph (Fin 3)) : 0 ≤ G.indepNum := Nat.zero_le _

end WrittenOnTheWallII.GraphConjecture7

reformulations.difference: Lean assumes `Nontrivial α`, whereas the source states the bound for simple connected graphs without explicitly excluding the one-vertex graph.
reformulations.equivalence_argument: A finite connected graph either has at least two vertices or is the one-vertex graph. In the latter case, the maximum local independence number is 0, the independence number is 1, and Ls is 0, so the bound is −2 ≤ 0. Thus the omitted case is automatic. The equivalence between the universally quantified nontrivial and nonempty connected formulations was proved in `/workspace/review/LsChecks.lean` as `Review.nontrivial_restriction_equiv`, without using the conjecture or any sorry-dependent lemma.

review.notes: Both the conjecture and the anonymous nonnegativity test were checked. The source's inequality and definitions match the Lean statement; its T status and attribution to DeLaVina, Fajtlowicz and Waller (2002) agree with the solved tag and docstring. Scratch proofs establish that Ls is an attained maximum on finite connected graphs, equals 0 on disconnected graphs, and equals 2 on K₂. Computable independence tests cover empty graphs, K₁, K₂, complete graphs, paths and stars. The casts preserve ordinary subtraction rather than truncated natural subtraction. All final scratch files compile. The live citation redirected to an inaccessible HTTPS endpoint, so archived primary-source pages and the linked paper were used.
